text:
maria: quick preflight — planning a nimble-40b serve canary this afternoon. need ✅ on weights path, tokenizer quirks, and RoPE/GQA config before we flip traffic. who can do a fast pass?
ajay: I can check weights + config. weights live at s3://redwood-models/nimble-40b/v1/weights.tar.lz4. can someone confirm sha256? I saw a small mismatch earlier.
sam: I grabbed the bundle earlier — computed sha256 is `b6f8c3e9a1d2f5c2...` (truncated). did you compare against model-registry entry?
ajay: registry shows `b6f8c3e9a1d2f5c2e9f1c2b3a4d5e6f7`. mismatch was missing a byte due to transfer. re-uploading now. :arrows_counterclockwise:
cleo: tokenizer note: nimble uses a modified SentencePiece model with custom unk handling. edge case: inputs with repeated non-breaking spaces cause tokenization to split differently from our current fallback. sample: ```text.encode('utf-8').replace(' ',' ')``` helps normalize.
maria: good catch. Sam/cleo — can we add a normalization step in tokenizer pipeline for the canary only? apply via serving config override?
sam: yes — can add `tokenizer.normalizers: [nbspace_to_space]` as a runtime override for the canary. small patch ready, will open PR.
ajay: on RoPE/GQA flags — current default has rope_scale: auto and gqa_mode: mixed. For nimble-40b we should pin rope_scale: 1.0 and gqa_mode: strict to avoid small attention drift in long-history tests.
tony: FYI, sliding window param needs max_context 4096 and window_stride 1024 for the product prompts. that interacts with kv-cache prefetch; ensure kv_prefetch_size >= 2*window_stride.
maria: can someone run the config linter and the runtime compatibility check? I want a green before I sign off.
cleo: running lint now — found one nit: `runtime.batcher.max_tokens` missing. recommended: 2048. also a config validation warning about `attn_impl: auto` fallbacking to slower path on our older kernels.
ajay: that attn_impl warning is expected on the older p4s in the dedicated pool. we can force `attn_impl: fused_unpadded` for the canary nodes that have newer cuda kernels. will tag node pool in deployment.
sam: quick tokenization example that previously broke evals: input -> tokens length jumps from 512 to 2000 because of a right-to-left mark inside JSON blobs. patching normalizer removes it in my local. sending diff in PR #4123.
maria: thanks. deploy-bot — schedule canary for 30m after uploads complete and autopromote=false.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: nimble-40b v1 -> pool:canary-rotary; start ETA 00:30. healthchecks: perf, mem, kv-cache-hit, tokenization-regressions.
cleo: one more check — regression harness flagged a 0.7% increase in perplexity on code-domain prompts for gqa_mode: mixed. pinning to strict brought it back inline.
ajay: then we pin gqa_mode: strict for canary, run 1h smoke, then if stable we test mixed in a/b.
maria: plan sounds good. Sam/Cleo/Ajay please post followup here when PRs merged + sha matches. I'll kick canary after that. :thumbsup:
sam: PR #4123 merged, tokenizer override applied in canary config. sha now matches registry.
cleo: lint fixed, attn_impl forced to fused_unpadded on canary nodes.
ajay: re-upload completed and checksum matches registry.
maria: launching canary in 5. monitoring channels: eng-runtime and incidents. ping me on-call if anything spikes.
tony: I'll watch kv-cache hit rate and windowing latency.
deploy-bot: canary started at 1748604983 — 5 instances. initial health: ok (startup mem high, warming caches).
